method: Accepted the user-supplied replacement page as the authoritative public presentation of the signed sampling agreement.
Inspected the supplied image and found that part of the email remained readable beyond the handwritten X marks.
Replaced the phone-number and email value regions with opaque white pixels and newly drawn black X marks before PDF creation.
Flattened the sanitized raster into a one-page PDF so no text layer, annotation or hidden object can reveal the obscured contact fields.
Rendered and visually inspected the completed PDF, regenerated both preview assets and updated every catalog, timeline, bundle and integrity reference.
Removed the superseded public PDF and previews after verifying the replacement hash, size, page count and readability.
